cutRule: frame k starts a shot when the block-motion residual res(k) > 0.045 and > 3x the median residual of k-8...k+8 (excluding k) + 0.01, and the 64-bin luma histogram chi-square vs k-1 > 0.05 or the thumbnail MAD > 0.06; at most one cut in any 4 frames

decode.check: best BT.709 video range, full-range R'G'B', chroma x offset 0.25, PSNR vs app decode 49.5/49.3/52.3/53.4/52.4 dB; app seek content offsets [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

film: Big Buck Bunny (sunflower, 60 fps, 1080p and 2160p renders), CC-BY 3.0 Blender Foundation
hdr: Look.natural (SDR->HDR highlight expansion) graded to HDR10 1000 nits with GradeRenderer.encodeGrade, then quantized to 10-bit limited-range BT.2020 NCL Y'CbCr 4:4:4 and back
motionRule: p90 over 16x16 blocks (480x270 luma, ±12 px exhaustive search per frame) of the summed displacement from frame n-2 to n+2, in 1080p px; strata low <8, medium 8-32, high 32-96, extreme >=96
splitRule: film time over the story (frames before the end credits): train 0-60%, val 60-80%, test 80-100%; the end credits + post-credits scene are the held-out 'credits' split; windows (center±3) never straddle a boundary

synthetic.finepattern: gray geq 128+100*sin(2pi(X+3.3N)/5.1)*sin(2pi Y/4.7): fine grating panning 3.3 px/frame (aliasing-ambiguous)
synthetic.occlusion: testsrc2 3840x2160 panning (6,3) px/frame behind a 480x480 testsrc moving -22 px/frame
synthetic.textscroll: credits text (CoreText) cropped with y=n*24: fast vertical scroll, 24 px/frame
synthetic.thinlines: gray geq 1.5 px diagonal lines every 48 px moving 7 px/frame

transitionRule: a fade/dissolve run is >= 5 consecutive frames where the thumbnail of k is explained by the average of k-s and k+s for s = 2 or 4 (blend error < 0.45x the error vs the nearer of the two), the change is real (> 0.012 MAD), block motion leaves a residual (> 0.012) and no cut lies within k±s; the span is padded by 2 frames
